name: @zeron/icons
description: The Zeron control-icon set for the web client — the same SVG assets the desktop embeds (crates/ui/assets/icons), generated into one module plus a React <Icon> that tints with currentColor. Generation is manual: run `pnpm regenerate` after changing the Rust assets; `pnpm check` verifies the generated module is fresh (nothing in CI runs it).
